mapper.select: SELECT scope.tenant_id, scope.data_role FROM orbit_user_scope scope INNER JOIN orbit_tenant tenant ON tenant.id = scope.tenant_id AND tenant.enabled = 1 INNER JOIN sys_user actor ON actor.user_id = scope.user_id AND actor.status = '0' AND actor.del_flag = '0' WHERE scope.user_id = #{userId} AND scope.enabled = 1
mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, section, name, enabled, revision, settings_json, secrets_json, verification_status, verified_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM orbit_system_configuration WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY section, name, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orbit_system_configuration ( id, tenant_id, section, name, enabled, revision, settings_json, secrets_json, verification_status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{section}, #{name}, #{enabled}, #{revision}, #{settingsJson}, #{secretsJson}, 'UNTESTED', UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) )
mapper.update: UPDATE orbit_system_configuration SET name = #{row.name}, enabled = #{row.enabled}, revision = #{row.revision}, settings_json = #{row.settingsJson}, secrets_json = #{row.secretsJson}, verification_status = 'UNTESTED', verified_at = NULL, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id = #{row.tenantId} AND id = #{row.id} AND revision = #{expectedRevision}

UPDATE orbit_system_configuration SET verification_status = #{status}, verified_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), revision = revision + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND revision = #{revision}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orbit_configuration_idempotency (tenant_id, actor_id, request_key, payload_hash, created_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{actorId}, #{requestKey}, #{payloadHash}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE request_key = request_key
mapper.select: SELECT payload_hash, response_json FROM orbit_configuration_idempotency WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND actor_id = #{actorId} AND request_key = #{requestKey} FOR UPDATE
